bool Remove(T drawable, bool disposeImmediately)

Parameters

drawable T

The drawable to be removed.

disposeImmediately bool

Whether removed item should be immediately disposed.

Returns

bool

Whether the drawable was removed.

Remarks

disposeImmediately should be true unless the removed item is to be re-used in the future. If false, ensure the removed item is manually disposed (or added back to another part of the hierarchy) else object leakage may occur.
